message:
perf(monitor): 调低系统定时任务执行频率并补全环境配置模板

- 将 health-check 频率由 5 分钟调至 30 分钟，减缓调度日志膨胀
- 将 cache-cleanup 与 online-cleanup 频率由 10/30 分钟调至 2 小时
- 补充部署与认证环境配置模板说明

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
fix: 强化认证安全与双数据库契约一致性
fix(web): 清理监控页面未使用的类型导入
feat(web): 增强 TreeTable 搜索与工具栏体验
refactor(web): 封装 TreeTable 并接入部门与菜单管理
refactor(web): 将定时任务管理列表重构为 DataTable 表格组件
refactor(web): 将缓存监控列表重构为 DataTable 表格组件
fix(web): 为菜单管理和部门管理树形列表添加水平滚动及最小宽度保护
fix(web): 优化 DataTable 表格自适应及操作列按钮溢出问题
fix(docker): upgrade patched alpine packages
fix(docker): harden runtime images
fix(ci): resolve contract, migration, and audit failures
fix(web): reset PageTabs on logout and preserve parent menu active state on subpages
feat(deploy): support independent WEB_VERSION/API_VERSION and single-component rolling updates
fix(deploy): allow web-only packages to bypass database type verification
fix(docker): use stable nginx:1.27-alpine tag in Dockerfile.web
fix(deploy): auto detect new offline images and sync APP_VERSION on redeploy
fix(file): copy absolute file url with origin instead of relative path
fix(web): fallback clipboard copy on non-secure http and enable gzip compression in nginx
fix(deploy): fix relative upload and tls volume paths in compose.app-only.yml and ensure recursive host permissions
feat(deploy): bind mount uploads to host directory for permanent file persistence and easy backup
fix(nginx): use ^~ prefix for /files/ and /api/ to prevent static regex hijack and enable image preview
docs: promote pnpm release interactive wizard across deployment guides and readmes
chore(git): ignore temporary test and deploy directories in .gitignore
fix(deploy): use dedicated compose.app-only.yml for EXTERNAL_DB mode to prevent dependency conflicts
perf(docker): switch api base image to node:24-alpine and add linux-musl-openssl-3.0.x binaryTarget
perf(docker): optimize api dockerfile size by pruning node_modules and eliminating redundant chown layer
fix(deploy): safely handle empty middleware array under bash set -u
fix(docker): remove redundant syntax directive to prevent Docker Hub resolve timeout
feat(deploy): interactive wizard for custom docker packaging (components, db, and middleware options)
docs(deploy): comprehensive overhaul of .env.deploy.example with beginner-friendly guides and checklists
fix(deploy): allow NODE_ENV override in compose and add COOKIE_SECURE example
fix(auth): fix cookie secure flag on http and add sys_job_log postgres migration

fix(docker): grant necessary capabilities to redis container to fix permission denied on data volume

- Add CHOWN, SETUID, SETGID, and DAC_OVERRIDE capabilities to redis service
- Add start_period to redis healthcheck and improve redis-cli command syntax

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(deploy): support external MySQL/PostgreSQL and Redis deployment mode

- Add docker/compose.external-db.yml to disable containerized DB and Redis
- Support EXTERNAL_DB=true in .env.deploy with host.docker.internal gateway
- Allow custom REDIS_URL override in docker-compose.yml
- Include compose.external-db.yml in offline docker packages

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(layout): adjust z-index layering between Header and PageTabs to prevent avatar menu overlap

- Elevate Header to z-35 so avatar dropdown menu stays above PageTabs
- Set PageTabs to z-20 so it remains sticky over main content without covering Header popovers

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

perf(deploy): optimize offline docker packaging speed and support architecture selection

- Add architecture prompt with auto-detection to prevent slow QEMU emulation on Apple Silicon
- Stream image export directly through gzip/pigz to avoid docker VM out of space errors
- Optimize final archive compression pipeline and avoid double compression of image layers
- Support loading both offline-images.tar and offline-images.tar.gz in docker up
- Add offline docker package option to the interactive release wizard

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(monitor): enhance online users page with search, table view, pagination and batch kick

- Add KPI overview cards for total users, client environments, and current session
- Support debounced search by username, email, and IP, plus browser/OS filters
- Implement standard data table layout with user avatars and environment badges
- Add client-side pagination, session details dialog, and auto-refresh toggle
- Support batch kick out and prevent self-kick misoperations

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: add PageTabs component and enhance cache monitor with category filtering and pagination

- Implement PageTabs store and layout component with auto-tracking, close actions, and persistence
- Enhance /monitor/cache with prefix category tabs (menu, dict, dept, captcha, security)
- Add Redis data type filter (string, hash, list, set, zset) and debounced key search
- Implement client-side pagination with Pagination component
- Add GET /api/monitor/cache/value/:key endpoint and inspection dialog with JSON formatting
- Mark protected security keys with Lock badge to prevent accidental deletion

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(log): fix field mapping for login and oper logs and add detail dialogs

- Align LoginLogItemDto fields with database (username, ip, location)
- Align OperLogItemDto fields with database (operName, url, ip)
- Add complete inspection dialog for login logs (IP, location, user, client UA, status, timestamp)
- Add complete inspection dialog for oper logs with JSON result preview and error stack trace

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(monitor): populate and display complete online user metadata

- Update OnlineUserItemDto to include userName, email, avatar, ip, browser, os, and loginTime
- Pass full user profile metadata to Redis in auth service and jwt strategy
- Render user Avatar, name, email, IP, browser/os tags, and formatted login time in online page

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

style(monitor): unify scheduled jobs counter card icons

- Replace custom background div tags with PlayCircle and PauseCircle icons
- Align running and paused card icon style with the total jobs Timer icon

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(monitor): fix scheduled job status display and add job logs tracking subpage

- Fix JobItemDto mapping with real status, running boolean, cron, and description
- Create SysJobLog schema across Postgres and MySQL and apply migration
- Automatically measure and record execution time, status, and exceptions in SystemJobsService
- Expose paginated GET /api/monitor/jobs/logs and DELETE /api/monitor/jobs/logs
- Sync OpenAPI schema and add /monitor/jobs/logs subpage with filtering and exception details

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(menu): unify sidebar navigation order by backend sort field

- Consolidate topMenus and menuGroups into a single sorted navItems list
- Ensure all top-level items (menus and directories) strictly respect backend sort order
- Set default sort for profile menu to 99 in seed.ts

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(menu): support show/hide visibility toggle across backend and frontend

- Add hidden field to MenuItemDto, UserMenuTreeNodeDto, and persist in create service
- Sync OpenAPI schema and regenerate frontend contract models
- Filter hidden menus from sidebar navigation while preserving routes and permissions
- Add show/hide visibility status badge and one-click toggle in menu management page
- Add visibility select dropdown in menu creation and edit dialogs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(menu): add toggle expand-all button and filter parent menu options

- Add one-click 'expand all / collapse all' toggle button in menu page header
- Filter out BUTTON types from parent menu select dropdown (only allow DIRECTORY and MENU)
- Recursively exclude editing menu node and its descendants to prevent circular parenting

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(ui): eliminate dialog scroll offset shift and focus ring clipping

- Add scrollbar-gutter: stable to scrollable containers to prevent content layout shifts
- Adjust dialog form scroll containers from asymmetric pr-1 to balanced px-1.5
- Replace ring-offset-2 on Input and SelectTrigger with ring-offset-0 to avoid overflow clipping

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(cors): allow PUT/DELETE methods, custom headers, and cross-origin resource policy in dev

- Explicitly allow PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and OPTIONS in CORS configuration
- Expose x-request-id and allow x-csrf-token and authorization headers
- Set crossOriginResourcePolicy to cross-origin in development to prevent CORP blocking
- Allow 127.0.0.1 and localhost origins dynamically in development without throwing 500

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs: update all references and hooks to unified db commands

- Add apps/api/prisma/db-cli.mjs to automatically detect DB_TYPE from env
- Consolidate fragmented db:*:pg and db:*:mysql into universal pnpm db:* commands
- Support --pg and --mysql flags for explicit target database overrides
- Update CI and release workflows to use unified commands
- Update CLAUDE.md and invariants.md documentation

docs: streamline local quick start

- Update E2E tests to validate x-request-id and deep health check contracts
- Add comprehensive production troubleshooting guide in docs/troubleshooting.md

- Add scripts/gen-crud.mjs to generate simple, readable, easy-to-modify CRUD scaffolds

- Add pnpm gen:crud command to package.json and document in CLAUDE.md

test: add contract and runtime response validation E2E tests

- Verify authentication cookie and double-submit CSRF protection
- Verify role authorization guards and menu tree response structure

- Verify paginated response wrapper format (code, data, pagination)
- Verify file upload validation and error response shape

feat: establish end-to-end OpenAPI contract and remove shared-types

- Add OpenAPI response wrappers and DTOs across all backend modules
